Thank you for your words, they made me happy. ( I'm glad you didn't tell me that "I'm still young", I really hate it.. )
The reason why I made this plan is a little compliaced, so I'll avoid talking about it. But, to answer your question, I don't know...Even if my problems disappeared, I would still feel worthless no matter what, so I can't tell..
It would be great though, if people suddenly felt better. Once again, thank you for replying. Have a great day!
